αἵματος: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg., with ἆσσον ’nearer to’ · also neut. gen. sg. of descent, after εἰμί: ’of (our) blood’ (ἐμός ἐσσι καὶ αἵματος ἡμετέροιο ’you are mine and of our blood’) · also neut. gen. sg. of the stuff filled with or smeared with: ’with blood’ (κνίσης τε καὶ αἵματος ἐμπλήσαντες; στῆθος … φύρσω αἵματος) · also neut. gen. sg. of material, with αὐλός: ’of blood’ (αὐλὸς … αἵματος ἀνδρομέοιο ’a jet of human blood’)
αὐτώ: αὐτός — self; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’themselves, the two of them’
βάντες: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., root aorist, tmesis ἀνά … βάντες = ἀναβάντες ’having embarked’  ·  also plain, + ἐς and acc. of place entered: ’having stepped into (the tubs)’ · also with ἐκ + gen., no tmesis: ’having stepped out of (the ship)’
βαῖνε: βαίνω — go, walk, step; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαινε); here tmesis μετέβαινε ’was following’ · also without tmesis: ’went’ (ἀμφ’ ἑνὶ δούρατι βαῖνε ’went astride one timber’)
διαμπερές: διαμπερές — right through, clean through; adv.
δῶχ: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δῶχ’ = δῶκε) · also aor. 1 sg., elided (δῶχ’ = δῶκα): ’I gave’
εὖχος: εὖχος — glory, triumph, the vaunt of victory; neut. nom./acc. sg.
κενεῶνα: κενεών — flank, the hollow of the body between ribs and hip; masc. acc. sg.
κεχαρισμένε: χαρίζομαι — do a favour, be dear to; perf. pass. part. voc. sg. masc.: ’dear’ (+ dat., ’dear to my heart’)
κοτύλην: κοτύλη — cup, small measure; fem. acc. sg.
κραιπνὰ: κραιπνός — swift, rushing; neut. acc. pl. used as an adverb: ’at a rush, swiftly’
κρατερὼ: κρατερός — strong, mighty; masc. nom. dual, with θεράποντε / ἐόντε: ’the two strong ones’
κτάμεναι: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic κτεῖναι)
μεμνημένος: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’mindful, remembering’
μώνυχας: μώνυξ — solid-hoofed, with an undivided hoof (of horses); masc./fem. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους
νὼ: ἐγώ — I; dual νώ, nom./acc.: ’we two, us two’
οἴω: οἶος — alone; masc. nom. dual: ’we two alone’ · also ὀΐω (οἴομαι) — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg., epic (= Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’ (οὐδὲ δύ’ οἴω ’nor two, I think’)
πάντοσ: πάντοσε — in every direction, on every side; adv., elided (πάντοσ’ = πάντοσε)
πήχεε: πῆχυς — forearm, arm; masc. acc. dual, epic -εε (= Attic πήχει) · also masc. nom. dual, subject (πήχεε λευκώ ’the two white arms’)
παμφανόωντα: παμφαίνω — shine all over, gleam brightly; pres. part. neut. acc. pl., diectasis (παμφανόωντα): ’all-shining’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἠέλιον: ’all-shining (sun)’
πειρηθῆναι: πειράω — try, test (+ gen.); aor. pass. inf. with active sense, Ionic η (= Attic πειραθῆναι)
πεποιθώς: πείθω — persuade; perf. πέποιθα trust, rely on (+ dat.); perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’trusting in’
ποινὴν: ποινή — requital, blood-price, penalty; fem. acc. sg.
πολύβουλος: πολύβουλος — of many plans, of much counsel; epithet of Athena, fem. nom. sg.
πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς because followed by a further enclitic (με): ’lest he somehow...’ · also accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’somehow’ (εἴ πώς οἱ εἴξειε ’in case he might somehow yield’)
σιγαλόεντα: σιγαλόεις — glossy, gleaming (sense uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χιτῶνα: ’gleaming’
σμερδαλέα: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’terribly’
ταρβήσας: ταρβέω — be afraid, fear; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having been frightened’
τοιαῦτα: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; demonstr. pron./adj., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’such things’
τούτω: οὗτος — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. dual (= Attic τούτω): ’these two’
τύχωμι: τυγχάνω — hit (+ gen.), happen upon; aor. subj. 1 sg. in -μι, epic (= Attic τύχω): ’I hit’, after αἴ κε
φάτνῃ: φάτνη — manger, crib, stall; fem. dat. sg.
φέροιεν: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they carry (it) off’
φαεινοῦ: φαεινός — shining, bright; masc. gen. sg.
φθόγγον: φθόγγος — voice, sound; masc. acc. sg.
ψυχή: ψυχή — soul, ghost, shade; fem. nom. sg.
ἀγαυοῦ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. gen. sg.
ἀγόρευ: ἀγορεύω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἀγόρευ’ = ἀγόρευε), unaugmented
ἀλκὶ: ἀλκή — strength, prowess, defensive might; fem. dat. sg.: ’in strength’
ἀπέλεθρον: ἀπέλεθρος — immense, boundless; acc. sg. (here fem., agreeing with ἶν)
ἀπόλοιτο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, die; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., expressing a wish
ἀτειρής: ἀτειρής — unwearied, unyielding; masc. nom. sg., with υἱός: ’unwearied in might’
ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv. · also ’idly, to no purpose, without ground’ (ἄλλως … ψεύδοντ’ ’tell lies idly’)
ἄνδρε: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. dual: ’two men’
ἐλάσαι: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. inf. act. (same form in Attic): ’to strike’
ἐμῶν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. gen. pl.
ἐπιβαινέμεν: ἐπιβαίνω — go upon, embark on, board; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἐπιβαίνειν), + gen.
ἐρυκακέειν: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain, detain; aor. inf., reduplicated epic -κακέειν (= Attic ἐρῦξαι): ’to hold back’
ἐσθλόν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἐστ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., elided (ἐστ’ = ἐστί)
ἐᾷ: ἐάω — allow, permit; pres. subj. 3 sg., contracted (also indic., same form)
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’from where she came’ (πόθεν ἔλθοι) · also in a relative clause with κε, prospective: ’(whoever) should come’ (ὅς κε … ἔλθοι) · also in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he go’ (μή … ἔλθοι ἀπαγγέλλων) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a general relative clause, without κε: ’whatever he might come in need of’ (ὅτευ κεχρημένος ἔλθοι)
ἔμπεδόν: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unshaken; neut. nom. sg., predicate with μένος
ἔχοντας: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. pl.: ’holding’
ἕτερόν: ἕτερος — other, another; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic γε
ἠέλιόν: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; acc. sg., accusative of extent: ’on into the dawn’ · also acc. after πρός: ’towards the dawn, the east’ (πρὸς ἠῶ) · also direct object of a verb of waiting: ’(waited for) Dawn’ (ἐμείναμεν Ἠῶ δῖαν) · also direct object of a verb of reaching: ’reach the dawn, live to see daybreak’ (ἠῶ ἵκοιτο) · also direct object of a verb of holding back: ’(held) Dawn (back)’ (Ἠῶ ῥύσατ’) · also direct object of a verb of bringing: ’(bring) Dawn’ (οἵ τ’ Ἠῶ … ἄγουσι)
ἡμείων: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; gen. pl., epic ἡμέων/ἡμείων (= Attic ἡμῶν): ’of us’
ἰάχων: ἰάχω — cry out, shout; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic: ’shouting’
ἰσχίῳ: ἰσχίον — hip, hip-joint; neut. dat. sg., local dat.: ’upon the hip’
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε) · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (printed the same; Attic accents it ἰδέ): ἴδε πῶμα ’look at the lid’
ἵππω: ἵππος — horse; masc. nom./acc. dual: ’two horses’
ἶν: ἴς — strength, force; fem. acc. sg. ἶν, elided in the text (ἶν’)
ὀλέσσῃς: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὀλέσῃς), with ἀπό in tmesis: ’you lose’
ὁρόω: ὁράω — see; pres. 1 sg., epic stretched form (= Attic ὁρῶ)
ῥινὸν: ῥινός — hide, skin; also a shield of hide; acc. sg. (its sense in the simile εἴσατο δ’ ὡς ὅτε ῥινόν was disputed in antiquity)
ῥῖνα: ῥίς — nose; fem. acc. sg. (ὑπὸ ῥῖνα ’beneath the nose’)
